# 8frame 1.5.0

8th Wall's fork of A-Frame, copied verbatim from
https://cdn.8thwall.com/web/aframe/8frame-1.5.0.min.js — the file
shark-ar-8thwall.html and soccer-ar-8thwall.html used to load from 8th Wall's
CDN. 8th Wall has wound down its hosted platform, and without this script the
AR pages don't start at all, so it's served from our own origin.

Source: https://github.com/8thwall/8frame — MIT License.
